sentences.en: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
sentences.zh: 菜单上有各种各样的菜肴。

sentences.en: Is it too early to order from the luncheon menu?
sentences.zh: 现在点午餐菜单上的菜还太早吗？

sentences.en: This restaurant changed their menu to offer healthier food choices.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅更换了菜单，提供更健康的食物选择。
